Topics covered in this PDF

BCOS-183 (Computer Application in Business) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Computers and their classification, cyber security, detailed project reports, business presentations, MS Excel PV and NPV, cloud computing
  • Software types, authentication and authorization, capital budgeting, word processing, operating systems, sole proprietorship, identity theft, correlation and regression

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: Tutor Marked Assignment, course title Computer Application in Business, coverage all blocks, maximum marks 100, attempt all questions. Section A: five questions (10 each). Section B: five questions (6 each). Section C: four questions (5 each)

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.
